scope: DEI-T52 task impact claims versus sealed semantic-guideline impact family
evidence: Native schema stores and reads back an actual sealed guideline impact preview for the same Board as the task.

Guideline receipt fields do not validate as the closed ImpactEvidence task block. REST/MCP refuse the real guideline receipt ID as a task execution reference with delivery_execution_set_unresolved; observed SQL models remain unchanged after commit.

REST/MCP accept a normal task impact declaration under card.conclusion.write. Its persisted record ID does not resolve as a guideline impact receipt, and the guideline CAS writer explicitly refuses the task ImpactEvidence object as an invalid adoption mutation.
Original sealed guideline receipt remains identical after both operations. Task impact remains claim_only and creates no implementation/delivery credit.
Packaged card_types.md and tool-docs/card.md describe guideline_impact_evidence as the separate sealed semantic-guideline family, not an alternative task-report field.
